title: 第1320章 恐怖的碰撞两章合一第1319章 神王领域两章合一
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 四方大人物微微一叹，心中对林羽充满了忌惮。
青绝天王的表现已经足够惊人了，大道争锋绝一出，诡异霸道，一般强者恐怕根本挡不住他那种手段，而今却在同境之中不敌。
特别是他喊出的那句话，让各方大人物心神颤抖，感觉到了不可思议。
七个道轮，林羽踏足了七个道轮中！
这简直就是捅破天的消息，太震撼了！
若是真的，这家伙岂不是洪荒大陆数十万年来最恐怖的天才？
元始山的颜老和谷老对视一眼，难掩震撼之色，他们想到了自家的道子。
“无极道子，他进入这个层次了吗？”
“现在不知道，但五年前那次出手，他是六个道轮，如今是否踏足七个道轮未可知。”谷老摇了摇头。
颜老脸色一阵变幻，数息后冷冷的抬头：“道子盖世无双，若这林羽都能踏足七个道轮中，那无极道子自然也能。”
“没错，是这个理。更何况林羽是否真的在七个道轮中难以验证，或许是青绝自身实力不济，感应错了而已。”
两个老道心中不甘，不想承认。
“轰隆隆！”
镇星手中，煌煌大日和雷霆星辰全部亮起，勾勒出了一幅无上道图，不断垂落各种大道神华，带着可毁灭一切的力量一次次的拍击而下。
但青绝天王的神王领域就如同神圣不可侵犯的领地一般，难以撼动。
唯有一股股恐怖无边的的神能炸开，碰撞出滔天的光芒席卷天地，淹没苍穹。
毁灭的力量从擂台上传导而出，压向四面八方。
有大人物冷哼一声，大手一挥，将余波震散在了空中。
但心中忍不住震撼。
林羽的攻击余波，竟然都能透过圣道擂台的封锁了？
这圣道擂台不要脸面的吗？还是说当真残缺的如此严重了？
似乎是在回应诸多大人物心中的疑惑，擂台巨震，漫天大道神则汹涌，圣道气息源源不断，一条又一条更加恐怖的道纹浮现，烙印在天穹之上。
这才隔绝了气息的泄露！
但是……
随着圣道纹络越来越多，整个古擂台突然变得朦朦胧胧了起来，遮掩了一切，封锁了一切，连王侯强者都看不穿，感知不到里面的情况了。
又是一瞬过后。
就连霸主也成瞎子了，无法感知到擂台上的一切。
全都被圣道法则完全封锁了。
“这是怎么回事？怎么看不到了？”不少大人物扭头，看向玉京皇主。
皇主此刻也有些懵逼，他也没想过会发生这种情况啊。
圣道擂台，怎么就全面复苏了？
“按道理来说，要擂台完全复苏，除非是半圣在其中对决才有可能，但眼下我也不知道什么情况了。”他苦笑了一声，道：“这种情况在记载中从未出现过。”
林羽和青绝的确很惊艳。
从他们刚刚的对决中就可以看到，两人的实力恐怕真的达到了那三位神话绝巅的层次了，可即便如此，在王爷和霸主眼中都依旧是蝼蚁啊，怎么会引动雷霆彻底复苏呢？
不应该才对！
“那现在怎么办？什么都看不到了。”有大人物皱眉问道。
“还能怎么办？等着他们对决结束，擂台自然就会沉寂下去了。”
“难道我等就只能这样干坐着等吗？”
不少大人物都有些不忿。
他们来此，最主要的不就是想亲眼看看这两位的实力到底有多强吗？结果不给看了。
气氛一时有些寂静。
content_en:
The big shots from all over the world sighed slightly, full of fear of Lin Yu in their hearts.
Qing Jue Tian Wang's performance was already astonishing enough. He was so strange and domineering in his Dao Zheng Jue that ordinary strong men would not be able to stop his methods, but now he was defeated in the same situation.
Especially the words he shouted made the big shots from all walks of life tremble and feel incredible.
Lin Yu stepped into the seven Tao Wheels!
This is simply shocking news!
If it were true, wouldn't this guy be the most terrifying genius in the prehistoric continent for hundreds of thousands of years?
Yan Lao and Gu Lao from Yuanshi Mountain looked at each other, unable to hide their shock. They thought of their own Taoism.
"Wuji Daozi, has he entered this level?"
"I don't know now, but in that attack five years ago, he was six Dao Wheels. It is unknown whether he has set foot on seven Dao Wheels now." Gu Lao shook his head.
Mr. Yan's face changed for a while, and after a few breaths he raised his head coldly: "The Taoist master is unparalleled in the world. If Lin Yu can step into the seven Taoist wheels, then the Wuji Taoist master can naturally do it too."
"Yes, that's the truth. What's more, it's difficult to verify whether Lin Yu is really in the Seven Dao Wheels. Maybe Qing Jue's own strength is not good enough and his induction is wrong."
The two old Taoists were unwilling to admit it.
"Boom!"
In Zhenxing's hands, the brilliant sun and thunderous stars all lit up, outlining a picture of the Supreme Dao. Various Dao divine flowers continued to fall down, striking down again and again with the power to destroy everything.
But Qing Jue Tian Wang's divine king domain is like a sacred and inviolable territory, which is difficult to shake.
Only waves of terrifying and boundless divine energy exploded, colliding with monstrous light that swept across the world and flooded the sky.
The power of destruction was transmitted from the arena, pressing in all directions.
"Hmph!"
A big shot snorted and waved his hand, scattering the aftermath in the air.
But I couldn't help being shocked.
The aftermath of Lin Yu's attack could actually pass through the blockade of the Holy Path Arena?
Is this Holy Way arena shameless? Or is it really so severely disabled?
As if in response to the doubts in the minds of many big figures, the arena shook violently, the sky was filled with turbulent Daoist principles, the aura of the Holy Dao continued to flow, and one after another more terrifying Dao patterns emerged and were imprinted on the sky.
This blocked the leakage of breath!
But...
As the number of holy lines increased, the entire ancient arena suddenly became hazy, covering everything and blocking everything. Even the powerful princes could not see through it and could no longer sense what was going on inside.
Another moment passed.
Even the Overlord is blind and unable to perceive everything in the arena.
All are completely blocked by the laws of the holy way.
"What's going on? Why can't you see it?" Many important people turned their heads and looked at Emperor Yujing.
The emperor was also a little confused at the moment. He never thought that this would happen.
How come the Holy Path Arena has fully recovered?
"Theoretically speaking, for the arena to be fully revived, it is only possible if a half-saint is dueling in it, but I don't know what the situation is now." He smiled bitterly and said: "This situation has never appeared in the records."
Lin Yu and Qing Jue were indeed amazing.
From their just duel, we can see that the strength of the two of them may have really reached the level of those three mythical pinnacles, but even so, they are still ants in the eyes of the prince and the overlord. How can they trigger Thunder to completely revive?
It shouldn’t be right!
"Then what should we do now? I can't see anything anymore." A big shot asked with a frown.
"What else can we do? When their duel is over, the arena will naturally become silent."
"Am I just going to have to sit here and wait?"
Many big shots were a little unhappy.
Isn't the main reason they come here just to see with their own eyes how strong these two are? The results are not shown.
The atmosphere was a little quiet for a while.
